units.source_text: 一休禅师在精灵祭时唱道：“用山城的瓜和茄子，照自然模样供神佛，加茂川的水亦如是。”

en.t: During the Festival of the Spirits, Zen Master Ikkyu sang: "Offer the melons and eggplants of Yamashiro to the gods and Buddhas just as nature made them; the water of the Kamo River is the same."

units.source_text: 我觉得他的心灵是无比美好的。

en.t: I feel that his spirit was incomparably beautiful.
